patch_description: Replace the subtractive covariance update with the Joseph stabilized form. The current update can gradually lose positive-semidefiniteness through floating-point cancellation, especially when adaptive measurement and process variances change rapidly. Joseph form preserves covariance consistency, keeps Kalman gains stable, and permits the reversal gate to operate on a more reliable noise estimate. Explicit symmetrization and diagonal flooring prevent numerical degeneracy without changing the causal, low-latency architecture.
